title: Fr1end
description: Adds a single, persistent dark entity that spawns in your world the moment you load a save and never leaves.  It bound exclusively to you. It cannot be killed, removed, or interacted with any way. It exist for one purpose only: to always be with you
body:
Now you're not alone!



The fr1end is permanently bound to you. It always follows you

A humanoid silhouette that slightly taller than you

It deals no damage. It does not attack. It does not block your path. It does not trigger any game events. Sometimes it speaks with you by cave or enderman sound. It simply follows you whole game whenever you go. As long as you play.



Enjoy the game with your new friend.
